text: The room has two kinds of visitor.

text: Buyers' browsers come from the internet, to type a card into the frame.

text: That entrance would become the most valuable box in the bank.

text: So the room has two narrow doors, and nothing else listens.
prefix: So the room has two narrow doors, and nothing else listens.

text: Think of a bank: a counter for the public, and a mail slot for partners.
prefix: Think of a bank: a counter for the public, and a mail slot for partners.

text: The first door is the counter.
prefix: The first door is the counter.

text: It is the payers' door.
prefix: It is the payers' door.

text: A buyer's browser connects to it over an encrypted line.
prefix: A buyer's browser connects to it over an encrypted line.

text: The counter opens that line with a certificate that every browser trusts.
prefix: The counter opens that line with a certificate that every browser trusts.

text: Then it looks at the request.
prefix: Then it looks at the request.

text: It passes on only the card frame's few requests: show the frame, send a card, send a code.
prefix: It passes on only the card frame's few requests: show the frame, send a card, send a code.

text: Every other request gets the answer "not found".

text: It also limits how fast one buyer can submit cards, at the bank's chosen rate.

text: It never limits simply loading the page.
prefix: It never limits simply loading the page.

text: The second door is the mail slot.
prefix: The second door is the mail slot.

text: It is the callers' door.
prefix: It is the callers' door.

text: A caller's connection arrives sealed.
prefix: A caller's connection arrives sealed.

text: On the outside of the envelope is the name of the service it wants.
prefix: On the outside of the envelope is the name of the service it wants.

text: The door reads only that name.
prefix: The door reads only that name.

text: It never opens the envelope.
prefix: It never opens the envelope.

text: It passes it on, still sealed, to the service behind it.
prefix: It passes it on, still sealed, to the service behind it.

text: Passing a connection along unopened is called pass-through.
prefix: Passing a connection along unopened is called pass-through.

text: Only a few names pass: the card vault, the adapters, and the login server.
prefix: Only a few names pass: the card vault, the adapters, and the login server.

text: Any other name, or no name at all, is refused.
prefix: Any other name, or no name at all, is refused.

text: The service behind the door then checks the caller itself, with the caller's certificate and its token.
prefix: The service behind the door then checks the caller itself, with the caller's certificate and its token.

text: So the door never needs a key to the caller's traffic.

text: What does this protect?
